words.definition: n. 乐器；仪器，工具；手段

examples.en: She plays three musical instruments.
Interest rates are an instrument of economic policy.
examples.zh: 利率是经济政策的一种手段。

words.usage: musical instrument（乐器）、precision instruments（精密仪器）高频；instrument of policy（政策工具）比喻义；instrumental adj. 有帮助的（instrumental in doing）；instrumentation 仪器使用。

confusables.note: instruction 指示，instr- 同头形近

collocations: instrument of policy 政策工具

words.definition: n. 正方形；广场 adj. 正方形的；公正的 v. 使一致；结清

examples.en: Tiananmen Square is vast.
His story doesn't square with the facts.

words.usage: town square（城镇广场）、square root（平方根）高频；square up（结账；摆出架势）；a square meal（一顿丰盛的饭）习语；squarely adv. 直截了当地。

words.definition: adj. 欢乐的，兴高采烈的；（英）微醉的

examples.en: The whole family had a merry time at Christmas.
He got a bit merry at the party.
examples.zh: 他在聚会上喝得有点微醺。

words.usage: Merry Christmas!（圣诞快乐）固定祝语；merry-go-round（旋转木马；轮回）高频；merriment n. 欢乐；merrily adv. 快乐地。

words.definition: v.（使）合并，融合

examples.en: The two banks merged to cut costs.
examples.zh: 两家银行为削减成本而合并。

examples.en: The two roads merge just outside town.

words.usage: merge with/into（与…合并/汇入）；merger n. 合并（a merger between banks）；merge lanes（合流车道）交通义；immerse/merge 形近。

confusables.note: emerge 出现，e- 同根形近

words.definition: adj. 唯一的，独有的 n. 鞋底；脚底

examples.en: She is the sole owner of the company.
examples.zh: 她是公司唯一的所有者。

examples.en: The sole of my shoe wore through.

words.usage: sole purpose/heir/owner（唯一目的/继承人/所有者）高频；sole and exclusive（唯一的，法律）；soul（灵魂）同音必辨！solely adv. 仅仅。
words.mnemonic: sole 唯一，soul 灵魂同音

words.definition: v. 推迟，延期

examples.en: The match was postponed because of heavy rain.
Don't postpone what you can do today.

words.usage: postpone sth to/until（把…推迟到）高频；postponement n. 延期；post（后）+ pone（放）→ 往后放；与 cancel（取消）之别：postpone 是改期。
collocations: postpone sine die 无限期推迟
words.mnemonic: post(后)+pone(放)→ 往后放 → 推迟

words.definition: adj. 大都市的 n. 大都市人

examples.en: He works for the metropolitan police.
Metropolitan areas keep expanding.

words.usage: metropolitan area/police（大都市区/首都警察）高频；metro（地铁；大都市）缩略；metro（母亲城市）+ politan（市民）；cosmopolitan（世界性的）形近。

confusables.note: cosmopolitan 世界性的，-politan 同尾

words.definition: n. 姿势，仪态；态度，立场 v. 摆姿势

examples.en: Poor posture causes back pain.
The government took a hard-line posture on trade.
examples.zh: 政府在贸易问题上摆出强硬姿态。

words.usage: good/bad posture（良好/不良体态）；adopt/take a posture（采取立场）高频；post（姿）→ 姿态；pose（摆姿势）同源。
collocations: adopt a posture 采取姿态

words.definition: n. 肖像，画像；生动的描述

examples.en: The gallery displays portraits of famous writers.
examples.zh: 美术馆陈列着名作家画像。

examples.en: Her novel paints a vivid portrait of rural life.
examples.zh: 她的小说生动描绘了乡村生活。

words.usage: paint/portrait of（画…像）；a portrait of life（生活的写照）比喻高频；portray v. 描绘；portrayal n. 描绘；portrait 拍照竖版义。

words.definition: n. 商人，批发商 adj. 商业的，货运的

examples.en: Venice grew rich on its merchant fleets.
The merchant ship vanished in the storm.

words.usage: merchant ship/navy（商船/商船队）高频；merchant bank（商业银行，英）；merc（贸易）同根 commerce；merchandise 商品同族。

words.definition: adv. 稍微，有点

examples.en: The instructions were somewhat confusing.
The price is somewhat higher than expected.

words.usage: somewhat + 形容词（略，有些）书面比 a bit 正式；somewhat of a（算是个…）：somewhat of a genius；someway 非词，用 somehow。

words.definition: n. 盖，盖子；眼睑（常用复）

examples.en: Put the lid on the saucepan.
His eyes were heavy-lidded with sleep.

words.usage: put/take the lid on（盖上/打开盖子）；put the lid on sth（终结某事）比喻高频；eyelid 眼睑；take the lid off（揭露）比喻。
collocations: put the lid on 盖上；终结

words.definition: n. 刀刃，刀片；叶片

examples.en: The blade of the knife was razor sharp.
Wind turbines have enormous blades.

words.usage: razor blade（剃须刀片）、turbine blade（涡轮叶片）高频；blade of grass（一片草叶）；bladed 有刃的；与 plug（插头）押韵词族。
collocations: a blade of grass 一根草叶

words.definition: v. 检查，视察；检阅

examples.en: The customs officer inspected my luggage.
examples.zh: 海关人员检查了我的行李。

examples.en: The general inspected the troops.

words.usage: inspect sth for（检查…有无）；inspection n. 检查（carry out an inspection）；inspector 检查员（police inspector 警督）；in（向）+ spect（看）。

confusables.note: respect 尊重，-spect 同根形近

collocations: inspect the troops 检阅部队
words.mnemonic: in(向)+spect(看)→ 看进去 → 检查

words.definition: n. （生理）组织；薄纸，纸巾

examples.en: The doctor examined the damaged tissue.
She blew her nose on a tissue.

words.usage: tissue paper（薄纸）、body tissue（身体组织）高频；tissue box（纸巾盒）；tissu（编织）→ 组织；与 towel（毛巾）之别：tissue 一次性。

confusables.note: issue 议题，t- 同头形近

words.definition: v. 偿还；报答

examples.en: He repaid the loan in monthly instalments.
I can never repay your kindness.

words.usage: repay a loan/debt（还贷/偿债）高频；repay sb for sth（为…报答某人）；repayment n. 偿还（repayment plan 还款计划）；re（回）+ pay。
collocations: repay a loan 偿还贷款
repay in kind 以其人之道还治其身
words.mnemonic: re(回)+pay(付)→ 付回 → 偿还

words.definition: v. 苦干，辛勤劳作 n. 辛苦劳动

examples.en: Farmers toiled in the fields from dawn to dusk.
examples.zh: 农民们起早贪黑在田里劳作。

examples.en: Years of toil ruined his health.
examples.zh: 多年操劳拖垮了他的身体。

words.usage: toil away/at（埋头苦干）书面高频；toil and moil（辛辛苦苦）旧习语；与 labour（劳动）、work（工作）之别：toil 强调辛苦繁重。
collocations: years of toil 多年辛劳
toil up the hill 气喘吁吁爬山

words.definition: v. 抽泣，呜咽 n. 抽泣

examples.en: The child sobbed herself to sleep.
He broke down and sobbed openly.
examples.zh: 他崩溃了，当众呜咽起来。

words.usage: sob one's heart out（痛哭）高频；sobbing 呜咽声；sob story（煽情故事）新闻高频；与 cry（哭）、weep（流泪）、wail（恸哭）辨析。
collocations: sob one's heart out 痛哭

words.definition: n. 等级制度；层级，阶层

examples.en: She rose quickly through the corporate hierarchy.
examples.zh: 她在公司层级中晋升很快。

examples.en: The church has a strict hierarchy.

words.usage: corporate/social hierarchy（公司/社会等级）高频；hierarchical adj. 等级的；hier（圣）+ archy（统治）→ 圣职等级；复数 hierarchies。

confusables.note: monarchy 君主制，-archy 同尾族

words.definition: v. 描绘，扮演；（某物）呈现

examples.en: The film portrays life in 1920s Shanghai.
examples.zh: 影片描绘了二十世纪二十年代的上海生活。

examples.en: He portrayed a detective in his last film.
examples.zh: 他在上一部电影中饰演侦探。

words.usage: portray sb as（把某人刻画为）高频；portrayal n. 描绘；portrait n. 肖像同根；tray（托）→ 摆在面前 → 展现。

confusables.note: betray 背叛，-tray 同尾形近

collocations: portray in films 在影片中扮演
words.mnemonic: port(摆)+ray → 摆在眼前 → 描绘
